resources.string:
The program is designed to redirect SSH, FTP, and Telnet links in Termux.
 For the application to work correctly, you must have Termux installed, configure Termux to allow commands from external applications,
 and grant this application the com.termux.RUN_COMMAND permission.
 To use SSH, you must install the openssh package (usually already installed in Termux).
 To use FTP and Telnet, you must install the inetutils package.
